articles.title: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
articles.description: Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are falling as both countries attack each other's shipping facilities and ports.

articles.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
articles.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

articles.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
articles.description: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

articles.title: North Korea launches missile amid declaration it must possess capability to counter strikes that would make enemy 'survival impossible'
articles.description: North Korea has declared it must possess the capability to counter any potential enemy moves with retaliatory strikes that would make their "survival and recovery impossible", according to reports.

articles.title: Eurovision changes rules to prevent winners involved in 'armed conflict' from hosting
